environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (HTTP API) in eu-west-1 with CloudFront distribution fronting the API. CloudFront has a custom origin request policy with viewer rate limiting via CloudFront Functions that tracks unique (IP, path) tuples in a CloudFront KeyValueStore with 5-second sliding window TTL, returning 429 after 2 requests per window per unique IP to the /oauth/callback path. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a usage plan with per-client throttle of 1 request per second with burst of 1. Lambda is deployed in a VPC with private subnets; outbound traffic routes through a NAT Gateway with a Network ACL on the private subnet that has an explicit DENY rule (rule number 50) for all traffic to destination 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local range including IMDS). The VPC also has a security group on the Lambda ENI with outbound rules allowing only TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 (no HTTP/80, no link-local). DNS resolution within the VPC uses Route 53 Resolver with a forwarding rule that returns NXDOMAIN for any query resolving to 169.254.x.x addresses.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API with usage plan (1 req/s, burst 1)
config.cloudfront: CloudFront Function rate limiter: 2 req/5s per IP on /oauth/callback, KeyValueStore-backed
